name: Beijing Dahao Technology Corp.,Ltd
summary: Beijing Dahao Technology Corp.,Ltd researches and develops, produces, and sells computerized control technology, motor drive technology, and related products in China and internationally. It offers embroidery machine control products; industrial sewing machine control products; flat-knitting machine control products; hosiery machine control products; glove machine control products; and intelligent factory products, as well as technical service and solutions. Beijing Dahao Technology Corp.,Ltd was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
